corpus.How many action cards are in a Voidrunne: A Voidrunner deck contains 45 action cards that represent piloting maneuvers, weapon systems, and shield configurations for spaceship combat. The cards are divided into three categories: offensive (15 cards), defensive (15 cards), and tactical (15 cards). Players build custom decks from the full set before each match, choosing a strategy that suits their play style.
corpus.How many action tokens does each player: Each player receives 6 action tokens per round in Chrono Clash, which can be spent on movement, combat, time manipulation, and resource gathering. The time manipulation mechanic allows players to spend extra tokens to undo actions or peek at future event cards. Efficient use of the limited action tokens is crucial, as unused tokens do not carry over between rounds.
corpus.How many alliance cards are in the Thron: The Throne Wars expansion contains 28 alliance cards representing political agreements, military pacts, and trade deals that players can forge with rival factions and neutral powers. Each alliance card specifies terms, benefits, and conditions under which the alliance can be broken. Strategic use of alliances can provide crucial advantages, but betraying an ally carries reputation penalties.
corpus.How many artifact slots does each explor: Each explorer in Tomb Raiders has 4 artifact slots in their inventory, limiting the number of ancient relics they can carry at any time. Players must make difficult choices about which artifacts to keep and which to leave behind when their slots are full. Artifacts provide various bonuses including enhanced combat abilities, puzzle-solving tools, and protection against tomb curses.
corpus.How many artifact tokens are in the base: The base Mythfall collection contains 15 artifact tokens scattered across the game map at the start of each session. Artifacts grant powerful one-time abilities or permanent stat bonuses to the heroes who collect them. Some artifacts are guarded by mythical creatures that must be defeated before the artifact can be claimed.
corpus.How many biome tiles are in the standard: The standard Terraform Genesis set includes 28 biome tiles that players place on the planetary grid during the terraforming process. Each biome tile is double-sided, with one side showing a barren landscape and the other showing a terraformed environment. Players flip tiles from barren to terraformed by spending the required resources, gradually transforming the planet into a habitable world.
corpus.How many biome types are in the Terrafor: The Terraform Genesis board features 9 biome types: ocean, desert, forest, mountain, grassland, tundra, volcanic, swamp, and crystal canyon. Players compete to terraform a barren planet by converting neutral hexes into habitable biomes. Each biome type requires different resources to establish and provides distinct benefits once terraformed.
corpus.How many blueprint cards are in the Fact: The Factory Floor base set contains 55 blueprint cards representing different machines, conveyor systems, and production modules that players can construct in their factories. Each blueprint specifies input resources, output products, space requirements, and energy consumption. Players compete to design the most efficient production lines by combining blueprints in clever configurations.
corpus.How many cards are in a Zephyr deck?: A Zephyr deck contains 72 cards divided into four elemental suits of 18 cards each: Wind, Storm, Gale, and Calm. Each suit includes numbered cards from 1 to 12 and six special action cards. The game emphasizes hand management and timing, with players trying to play all their cards before opponents by matching elements or numbers.
corpus.How many chapters are in a standard Myth: A standard Mythos Unraveled campaign consists of 12 chapters, each presenting a self-contained mystery that connects to the overarching narrative of eldritch horror threatening a 1920s coastal town. Each chapter takes approximately two to three hours to play and introduces new locations, characters, and supernatural threats. Players' choices in earlier chapters affect the options available in later ones.
corpus.How many character abilities does each h: Each hero in Shadow Legends has 5 character abilities that define their role in the adventuring party. Abilities are categorized as one passive trait, two active combat skills, one utility skill, and one ultimate ability that charges over multiple turns. Players can customize their heroes by selecting ability upgrades at key story milestones.
corpus.How many character classes are in Shadow: Shadowpact includes 14 character classes, each with a unique set of abilities and a distinct role in the cooperative dungeon-crawling experience. Classes range from frontline warriors like the Ironclad and Berserker to support roles like the Mystic Healer and Shadow Weaver. Players select their class at the start of each campaign and can unlock advanced abilities as they progress.
corpus.How many city tiles are in the Metropoli: The Metropolis Builder starting pack contains 32 city tiles representing different urban zones including residential blocks, commercial districts, industrial areas, parks, transportation hubs, and civic buildings. Players place tiles on a shared city grid, earning points for efficient urban planning and creating neighborhoods with compatible adjacent zones. Penalties apply for placing incompatible zones next to each other.
corpus.How many council seats are contested in: The Intrigue of Ravenmoor features 13 council seats that players compete to fill with their loyal supporters through a combination of political maneuvering, bribery, and strategic alliances. Each council seat controls a different aspect of city governance, such as the treasury, the guard, the trade commission, or the judiciary. The player who controls the most seats at the end of five rounds wins.
corpus.How many crew members does each player s: Each player starts with 12 crew members in Corsair's Gambit, distributed among roles including navigator, gunner, lookout, and deckhand. Crew members can be assigned to different stations on the player's ship to improve specific capabilities like speed, firepower, or cargo capacity. Losing crew members in combat weakens the ship until replacements can be recruited at port.
corpus.How many crew roles exist in the Starshi: The Starship Enigma game features 11 crew roles: captain, pilot, navigator, engineer, weapons officer, communications officer, science officer, medical officer, security chief, cargo master, and diplomatic envoy. Each role has unique abilities that contribute to the ship's overall effectiveness. In cooperative mode, players must coordinate their roles to handle the various crises that arise during interstellar voyages.
corpus.How many dice are used in a round of Dra: Each round of Dragon's Gambit uses 8 dice: six standard twelve-sided dice and two special dragon dice featuring unique symbols such as fire breath, wing gust, tail sweep, and dragon roar. Players roll their dice pool and assign results to attack, defend, or activate special dragon abilities. The dragon dice can produce spectacular effects that dramatically alter the course of battle.
corpus.How many dice are used in a round of Thu: Each round of Thunderstone uses 7 dice: five standard six-sided dice and two special thunder dice that feature unique symbols including lightning bolts, shields, and critical strike markers. Players roll all seven dice simultaneously and then allocate results to different actions. The thunder dice add an element of unpredictability that can dramatically shift the outcome of encounters.
corpus.How many dungeon levels are in the Crypt: The Crypts of Malachar base set features 10 dungeon levels of increasing difficulty, with each level containing unique room layouts, monster encounters, and treasure hoards. Players must clear each level before descending to the next, facing a powerful boss monster at every fifth level. The final level culminates in a confrontation with the lich king Malachar himself.
corpus.How many elemental cards are in the Prim: The Primal Surge deck contains 64 elemental cards divided equally among four primal elements: 16 fire cards, 16 water cards, 16 earth cards, and 16 air cards. Each element has its own attack patterns, defensive capabilities, and combo potential. Players build decks by selecting cards from two or more elements, creating hybrid strategies that can catch opponents off guard.
corpus.How many event cards are in the Plague C: The Plague Chronicles deck contains 40 event cards that drive the narrative and introduce challenges throughout the cooperative survival game. Events include disease outbreaks, supply shortages, refugee crises, bandit attacks, and rare moments of hope like discovering a cache of medicine. Players draw one event card each round and must collectively decide how to respond.
corpus.How many faction cards are in the Warfro: The Warfront Allegiance set contains 50 faction cards representing five competing military powers of 10 cards each. Each faction has a distinct combat philosophy: the Iron Legion emphasizes defense, the Storm Riders focus on mobility, the Shadow Guild uses stealth and sabotage, the Flame Order employs devastating attacks, and the Tide Compact controls the seas.
corpus.How many fleet cards does each player st: Each player starts with 8 fleet cards in Aether Seas, representing their initial armada of sky ships that sail through floating island archipelagos. The starting fleet includes two frigates, two corvettes, two cargo vessels, one flagship, and one scout. Players can expand their fleet by constructing new ships at controlled sky docks throughout the game.
corpus.How many garrison slots are in each fort: Each fortress in Siege of Ironhold has 4 garrison slots where players can station different unit types to defend against attacking armies. The slots are designated as wall, tower, gate, and keep, each providing different defensive bonuses to the units stationed there. Strategic placement of limited troops across these slots is key to surviving prolonged sieges.
corpus.How many gold coins does each player beg: Each player begins with 15 gold coins in Merchant Prince, representing their starting capital for building a commercial empire across the Mediterranean trade network. Gold is spent on purchasing goods, hiring ships, bribing officials, and establishing trading posts in foreign ports. Successful trades generate profit, while poor investments or pirate attacks can quickly deplete a player's reserves.
corpus.How many guild tokens are in a Tradecraf: A Tradecraft starting set includes 18 guild tokens representing different merchant guilds that players can recruit to enhance their trading capabilities. Each guild token provides a unique bonus such as reduced shipping costs, access to exclusive markets, or protection from pirate raids. Players compete to recruit the most valuable guild combinations.
corpus.How many harvest tokens are in the Farms: The Farmstead Chronicles base set includes 40 harvest tokens representing crops and livestock produced on the player's farm throughout the growing seasons. Harvest tokens come in five types: grain (10), vegetables (8), fruit (8), dairy (7), and livestock (7). Players sell harvest tokens at the market for coins, with prices fluctuating based on supply and demand driven by event cards.
corpus.How many hero cards are in the Champions: The Champions of Eldoria deck contains 36 hero cards representing warriors, mages, rogues, and clerics from six different kingdoms. Each kingdom contributes six heroes with complementary abilities designed to work together. Players draft heroes to form their adventuring party, and the synergy between chosen champions determines the effectiveness of the team.
corpus.How many hex tiles form the standard Neb: The standard Nebula Conquest board is formed by 37 hex tiles arranged in a honeycomb pattern, with each hex representing a stellar system or deep space region. The board is modular, with tile placement varying each game based on scenario cards. Central hexes tend to be resource-rich but heavily contested, while outer hexes offer safer but less rewarding positions.
corpus.How many hexes are on a standard Duskfal: A standard Duskfall board consists of 127 hexes arranged in a circular pattern representing a post-apocalyptic wasteland. The hexes include resource zones, radiation fields, safe havens, and contested territories. Players explore the map by revealing face-down hex tiles, encountering threats and opportunities as they expand their settlements.
corpus.How many invention tokens are in the Age: The Age of Discovery set includes 18 invention tokens representing technological breakthroughs that advance a player's civilization. Inventions range from basic tools like the compass and printing press to advanced technologies like steam engines and telegraphs. Each invention provides immediate benefits and unlocks access to more advanced inventions further up the technology tree.
corpus.How many islands are on a standard Tidal: A standard Tidalwave board features 9 islands connected by sea routes that shift as tidal cards are played throughout the game. Each island produces different resources and offers unique building opportunities. The dynamic water levels created by tidal shifts mean that some routes become navigable while others are cut off, forcing players to constantly adapt their strategies.
corpus.How many mana crystals does each player: Each player begins with 4 mana crystals in Arcane Duels, which are spent to cast spells and summon creatures during their turn. Players gain one additional mana crystal at the start of each turn, up to a maximum of ten. The escalating mana supply means that early turns feature small skirmishes while late-game turns see powerful spells and legendary creatures entering the battlefield.
corpus.How many minion tokens are in a Darkspir: A Darkspire Dungeon starting set includes 48 minion tokens representing the various creatures and monsters that inhabit the dungeon. Minion types include skeletons, goblins, shadow wraiths, cave trolls, and the dreaded darkspire guardians. The dungeon master player deploys these tokens to oppose the hero players as they delve deeper into the dungeon.
corpus.How many minion types exist in the Overl: The Overlord's Siege game features 13 minion types that the overlord player can recruit and deploy against the hero players. Minion types include goblins, orcs, trolls, dark knights, shadow assassins, necromancers, fire imps, frost wraiths, stone golems, plague rats, bat swarms, spider broodlings, and the elite dragon guard. Each type has unique combat stats and special abilities.
corpus.How many mission cards are in the Covert: The Covert Ops deck contains 36 mission cards divided into four categories: infiltration (9 cards), extraction (9 cards), sabotage (9 cards), and intelligence (9 cards). Each mission specifies a target, difficulty level, required equipment, and potential complications. Players select missions based on their agents' specializations and available resources.
corpus.How many monster tokens are in the Night: The Nightmare Dungeon starting set includes 56 monster tokens representing a bestiary of dungeon-dwelling creatures organized into seven monster families of eight tokens each. Monster families include undead, demons, beasts, constructs, aberrations, elementals, and the dungeon boss and its elite guards. The dungeon master distributes monster tokens across dungeon rooms according to encounter tables.
corpus.How many mutation cards are in the Genom: The Genome Wars deck contains 44 mutation cards representing genetic modifications that players can apply to their creature armies. Mutations include enhanced strength, venomous attacks, armored plating, camouflage, flight capability, and regeneration. Players combine mutations to create unique creature variants, with some combinations producing powerful synergies and others creating unstable organisms.
corpus.How many outpost tokens are in the Void: The Void Frontier base set includes 21 outpost tokens that players deploy on the star map to establish their presence in unexplored space. Outposts serve as supply points, early warning stations, and staging areas for fleet operations. Each player begins with three outpost tokens and can manufacture additional ones at their home base using collected resources.
corpus.How many pieces does each player start w: Each player starts with 22 pieces in Ironforge, comprising 10 infantry, 6 cavalry, 4 siege engines, and 2 commanders. The game simulates medieval fortress warfare, with players deploying their forces across a modular castle board. Commanders have special abilities that can turn the tide of battle when positioned strategically.
corpus.How many portal tiles are on the Riftwal: The Riftwalk board contains 6 portal tiles that connect different regions of the dimensional maze. Portals allow instant travel between distant parts of the board but require spending dimensional energy tokens to activate. Each portal leads to a fixed destination, and memorizing the portal network is essential for efficient movement through the rifts.
corpus.How many power gems does each player beg: Each player begins with 3 power gems in Runebind, which serve as the primary resource for casting rune spells and activating magical effects. Power gems regenerate at the start of each turn, and players can increase their maximum gem capacity by controlling specific board locations. Managing gem expenditure is the central strategic challenge of the game.
corpus.How many provinces are contested in the: The Warpath campaign map features 16 contested provinces arranged across a continental landmass divided by rivers and mountain ranges. Each province provides strategic advantages such as resource production, defensive terrain, or access to trade routes. Players begin with control of one home province and expand by conquering adjacent territories through military campaigns and diplomatic negotiations.
corpus.How many quest cards are in the Wanderer: The Wanderer's Path base set contains 45 quest cards organized into three difficulty categories: 15 novice quests, 15 journeyman quests, and 15 master quests. Each quest describes an objective, potential rewards, and possible complications that may arise during completion. Players choose which quests to pursue based on their characters' strengths and current equipment.
corpus.How many quest cards are in the Wyrmwood: The Wyrmwood Adventures starter set contains 50 quest cards organized into five difficulty tiers of 10 quests each. Quests range from simple fetch missions and monster hunts to complex multi-part story arcs involving mystery solving and diplomatic negotiations. Completing quests earns experience points and loot that help heroes prepare for the increasingly dangerous challenges ahead.
corpus.How many relic cards are in the Tomb of: The Tomb of Eternity expansion includes 33 relic cards that represent ancient artifacts discovered in the depths of the tomb. Each relic grants unique powers ranging from combat bonuses to special movement abilities and puzzle-solving aids. Relics are found by successfully completing tomb chambers, and players must decide which relics to keep given their limited inventory slots.
corpus.How many resource types exist in Crystal: Crystalheim features 8 resource types: fire crystal, ice shard, thunder stone, shadow essence, light prism, earth core, water pearl, and void fragment. Players collect resources by controlling territory hexes that produce specific crystal types. Combining resources in specific patterns allows players to construct powerful structures and summon elemental guardians.
corpus.How many rounds are in a standard Dragon: A standard Dragonscale match consists of 5 rounds, with each round representing a season in the dragon-taming calendar. During each round, players draft dragon eggs, train their hatchlings, and compete in aerial combat tournaments. Points accumulate across all five rounds, and the player with the highest total score at the end of the final round wins.
corpus.How many rune stones does each player st: Each player starts with 8 rune stones in Runecaster, drawn randomly from a bag containing stones inscribed with ancient symbols. Players cast rune stones onto the game board, with their landing positions and orientations determining the magical effects produced. Skilled players learn to control their throws to consistently produce desired spell patterns.
corpus.How many sanctuary tiles are on a Pilgri: A Pilgrimage of Ash board contains 7 sanctuary tiles positioned at key intersections along the pilgrimage route. Sanctuaries provide healing, equipment upgrades, and quest completion opportunities for weary travelers. Reaching a sanctuary also allows players to save their progress and recruit new companions for the difficult journey ahead.
corpus.How many scouts does each player deploy: Each player deploys 10 scouts at the start of Recon Strike, positioning them across the battlefield map to gather intelligence on enemy positions. Scouts have limited combat capability but provide crucial information about terrain, enemy movements, and hidden objectives. Losing scouts reduces a player's battlefield awareness, making them vulnerable to ambushes and surprise attacks.
corpus.How many sectors are in the Hyperdrive C: The Hyperdrive Conflict galaxy map is divided into 42 sectors arranged in a spiral pattern radiating outward from the galactic core. Each sector contains star systems with varying strategic value, from resource-rich mining colonies to military strongholds and research facilities. Players expand their empires by claiming adjacent sectors and defending them from rival factions.
corpus.How many sectors are on a standard Nebul: A standard Nebula Drift board features 36 sectors arranged in a 6 by 6 grid, each representing a region of space with unique properties. Sectors can contain asteroid fields, nebula clouds, space stations, wormholes, or empty void. Players navigate their fleets through the sectors, competing to control valuable trade routes and resource-rich regions.
corpus.How many settlement tiles are in the Fro: The Frontier Dawn box includes 24 settlement tiles representing different frontier buildings such as homesteads, trading posts, mills, saloons, sheriff offices, and general stores. Players place settlement tiles to develop their frontier town, with each building providing specific benefits. The spatial arrangement of buildings matters, as adjacent structures can create synergy bonuses.
corpus.How many spell cards are in the base Arc: The base Arcane Duel set contains 60 spell cards distributed across five schools of magic: fire (12 cards), water (12 cards), earth (12 cards), air (12 cards), and arcane (12 cards). Each school has its own play style, with fire focusing on direct damage, water on healing and defense, and arcane on card manipulation. Players construct decks by combining spells from up to three schools.
corpus.How many spell components are in the Alc: The Alchemy Wars base set includes 72 spell components divided into six ingredient types of 12 components each: herbs, minerals, essences, crystals, powders, and elixirs. Players collect components through exploration and trading, then combine them using recipe cards to create potions, bombs, enchantments, and transmutations. The vast number of possible combinations encourages creative experimentation.
corpus.How many starships does each fleet start: Each fleet starts with 8 starships in Galactic Armada: two battleships, two cruisers, two destroyers, one carrier, and one command vessel. Players can construct additional ships at starbases using collected resources, but each ship type requires different materials and construction time. Fleet composition and formation are crucial tactical decisions that determine the outcome of space battles.
corpus.How many supply tokens are in the Fronti: The Frontier Settlement starting kit contains 24 supply tokens representing essential resources like food, water, timber, and tools needed to establish a new colony. Players distribute supply tokens among their settlement buildings and expedition parties, balancing the needs of a growing population with the demands of exploration. Running out of supplies triggers crisis events that can devastate an unprepared settlement.
corpus.How many terrain cards are in the Wilder: The Wilderness Survival deck contains 44 terrain cards representing the varied environments that players encounter during their journey through untamed wilderness. Terrain types include dense forest, open meadow, rocky ridge, river crossing, swamp, desert stretch, mountain pass, coastal cliff, and more. Each terrain card presents unique survival challenges and resource gathering opportunities.
corpus.How many terrain types are in Frostpeak: Frostpeak Conquest features 11 terrain types: tundra, glacier, frozen lake, snowfield, mountain peak, ice cave, hot spring, alpine forest, rocky outcrop, crevasse, and aurora zone. Each terrain type affects movement speed, combat bonuses, and resource availability differently. Controlling diverse terrain types is essential for a balanced strategy.
corpus.How many tiles are in a Stormhaven tile: A Stormhaven tile set includes 96 tiles representing different terrain types such as rocky shores, deep waters, harbors, and storm zones. Players build the game board collaboratively by placing tiles each turn, creating a unique island map for every session. The variable board ensures high replayability and encourages adaptive strategy.
corpus.How many tiles make up the Echoing Caver: The Echoing Caverns dungeon board is composed of 81 tiles arranged in a 9 by 9 grid, with each tile representing a different cavern chamber. Tiles include crystal grottos, underground rivers, mushroom forests, bat colonies, and the lair of the cave dragon at the center. The board is assembled randomly at the start of each game, ensuring a unique dungeon layout every time.
corpus.How many trade goods does each merchant: Each merchant starts with 20 trade goods in Silk Road Legends, representing a diverse cargo of silk, spices, precious metals, ceramics, and other commodities valued along the ancient trade routes. Players move their caravans across the map, buying goods cheaply at production centers and selling them at premium prices in distant markets. Profits are reinvested in better camels, guards, and trade agreements.
corpus.How many trade routes are in the base Me: The base Merchant Winds set includes 20 trade routes connecting the game's various port cities across a network of sea lanes. Each trade route has a distance value, danger rating, and list of goods that can be profitably transported along it. Players compete to establish the most lucrative trading network by claiming routes and fulfilling delivery contracts.
corpus.How many trap cards are in the Labyrinth: The Labyrinth of Echoes base set contains 30 trap cards that are shuffled into the dungeon deck and revealed as players explore the labyrinth. Trap types range from simple pit falls and poison darts to complex magical snares that affect the entire party. Players can attempt to disarm traps using their characters' skills, with failure resulting in damage or other penalties.
corpus.How many treasure cards are in the Pirat: The Pirate's Bounty deck contains 38 treasure cards representing different valuables that pirates can plunder from merchant ships and coastal towns. Treasures range from gold doubloons and silver bars to rare spices, exotic gems, ancient maps, and cursed artifacts. Each treasure has a point value, but cursed items impose penalties if a player holds too many at the end of the game.
corpus.How many tribe tokens are in the Dawn of: The Dawn of Tribes starter includes 30 tribe tokens representing the population units that players manage throughout the civilization-building game. Tribes can be assigned to gathering food, constructing buildings, training warriors, or exploring unknown territories. Managing the allocation of limited tribe tokens between these competing priorities is the core strategic challenge.
corpus.How many upgrade slots does each ship ha: Each ship in Starfall Armada has 6 upgrade slots that can be fitted with weapons, shields, engines, sensors, cargo modules, or special equipment. The slots are divided into three categories: two weapon mounts, two utility bays, and two core systems. Players customize their fleet by choosing upgrades that complement their overall battle strategy.
corpus.How many victory flags are contested in: Battlefront Zero features 7 victory flags positioned at strategic locations across the battlefield map. Players must capture and hold these flags to earn victory points each round. Flags closer to the center of the map are worth more points but are harder to defend due to their exposure. The game ends when one player accumulates a set number of victory points or eliminates all opposing forces.
corpus.How many victory points are needed to wi: A player needs 25 victory points to win Moonrise, a competitive territory control game set on a colonized lunar surface. Points are earned by establishing bases, completing research objectives, controlling resource deposits, and fulfilling secret mission cards. The first player to reach 25 points triggers the final round, giving other players one last chance to surpass them.
corpus.How many weapon types exist in the Gladi: The Gladiator Arena game features 9 weapon types: sword, spear, trident, net, axe, mace, bow, shield, and dual daggers. Each weapon type has distinct attributes for attack range, damage, speed, and special abilities. Players equip their gladiators before each bout, choosing weapons that complement their fighting style and counter their opponent's expected loadout.
corpus.How many weather cards are in the Storm: The Storm Cycle deck contains 28 weather cards that determine environmental conditions each round, affecting movement, combat, and resource gathering for all players. Weather types include clear skies, light rain, heavy storm, blizzard, fog, drought, and hurricane. Players must plan their actions with weather forecasts in mind, as certain strategies become impossible during severe conditions.

corpus.text: The Swedish krona is the official currency of Sweden, symbolized by SEK and subdivided into 100 ore. The krona has been Sweden's currency since 1873 and is issued by the Sveriges Riksbank, the world's oldest central bank, founded in 1668. Sweden has become one of the most cashless societies in the world, with digital payments dominating everyday transactions.
corpus.title: Sweden currency reference

corpus.text: German is the official language of Germany, spoken as a first language by the vast majority of the country's approximately 83 million residents. German is also an official language of Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Belgium, and Liechtenstein. The language belongs to the West Germanic branch of the Indo-European language family and is known for its compound word formation.
corpus.title: Germany official language reference

corpus.text: Triton is the largest moon of Neptune, with a diameter of 2,707 kilometers, making it the seventh-largest moon in the Solar System. Discovered by William Lassell just 17 days after Neptune itself was found in 1846, Triton is unique among large moons for its retrograde orbit, suggesting it was captured from the Kuiper Belt rather than forming alongside Neptune.
corpus.title: Neptune largest moon reference

corpus.text: The new shekel is the official currency of Israel, symbolized by ILS and subdivided into 100 agorot. The new shekel was introduced in 1985 at a rate of 1,000 old shekels to 1 new shekel as part of an economic stabilization plan. The Bank of Israel manages the currency, and Israeli banknotes feature portraits of notable figures from the country's cultural and intellectual history.
corpus.title: Israel currency reference

corpus.text: The zloty is the official currency of Poland, symbolized by PLN and subdivided into 100 groszy. The name zloty literally means golden in Polish, reflecting the historical use of gold coins. The modern zloty was reintroduced in 1995 at a rate of 10,000 old zlotych to 1 new zloty following a period of hyperinflation in the early 1990s.
corpus.title: Poland currency reference

corpus.text: Ljubljana is the capital and largest city of Slovenia, situated in the center of the country along the Ljubljanica River. The city has a population of approximately 280,000 and serves as the cultural, educational, economic, political, and administrative center of the country. Ljubljana's Old Town features baroque and Art Nouveau architecture, with the hilltop Ljubljana Castle overlooking the city.
corpus.title: Slovenia capital city reference

corpus.text: Guglielmo Marconi is widely credited with inventing the radio, successfully demonstrating wireless telegraphy in 1895 and receiving a patent for his system in 1896. In 1901, Marconi achieved the first transatlantic radio transmission from Cornwall, England to Newfoundland, Canada. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1909 for his contributions to wireless telegraphy.

corpus.text: Pico de Orizaba is the highest mountain in Mexico, reaching 5,636 meters (18,491 feet) above sea level.
